description: E07-T02 / bugfix #1556: revision hash lock enforcing 21-database-schema.md §9.3 rule 9 ("migrations are forward-only in production"). Each entry pins the SHA-256 of an applied revision file's bytes; `tools/ci/verify_migration_lockfile.py` (run by the `migrations` CI job) recomputes the digest of every file listed here and fails the build with the exact rule-9 message if any applied revision has been edited. Adding a *new* revision requires adding its entry here in the same PR; the checker also fails if a versions/*.py file exists on disk with no lockfile entry, or if the down_revision chain implied by revision ids does not match the file's actual `down_revision`.
